description: Memorial aircraft near the mess building of the Satakunta Air Wing at Pirkkala.

Converted for electronic reconnaissance in the Netherlands and Finland between 1989 and 1991 and retired in 2018. Now a monument in the military area at Pirkkala. Earlier identities OH-KFA TF-FLJ TF-FIJ and PH-FGR.
